contemporaneous_checkpoint_projection.interpretation: The position is open and provisional. Early marked loss, favorable excursion, and giveback do not establish strategy edge or exit quality. Score only after the actual venue close and exact lifecycle reconciliation.

analysis.diagnosis: The first current-v51 SPCX signal was independently reproduced and routed with the intended exact pressure, side, stop, profit-lock, opposite-intent, and timer contract. No technical entry or protection defect is present at this boundary.
failure_modes: The lifecycle can still lose at the protective stop or through adverse exit slippage.
A later exact WebSocket mark gap above 5000ms would technically censor the replay even though the actual venue lifecycle remains observable.
One short lifecycle cannot establish bidirectional expectancy, profit-lock efficacy, or stable profitability.
Open-path endpoint economics can reverse before the actual exit.
analysis.falsifier: Any row-level mismatch at close between the live stop, opposite-intent, completed-bar profit-lock, maximum-hold branch, realized fees, funding, fills, or timing and the corrected report-only replay invalidates technical parity.

recommendation.why_now: The current evidence supports preserving and resolving the exact prospective lifecycle rather than reacting to its early path.
recommendation.validation_completed: Independent source decision parity, route identity, entry fills, fee, slippage, acknowledgement latency, full reduce-only stop coverage, and bound exit plan were reconciled. Exact WebSocket mark coverage was provisionally recomputed through the declared checkpoint boundary and must be frozen with its full part manifest at close.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Actual exit, realized fees and funding, exit slippage and latency, stop or profit-lock behavior, full-path mark continuity, and long-side source-native evidence.
recommendation.success_metrics: Exact replay parity on the resolved lifecycle, complete technical evidence, actual after-cost PnL, largest-winner-insensitive economics only after a materially larger sample, and at least one resolved lifecycle per configured side.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Unprotected exposure, source/backend mismatch, exit-contract mismatch, anomalous fill or fee behavior, or a later sufficiently powered compatible sample demonstrating adverse after-cost expectancy.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Keep the lifecycle untouched, capture its actual close, and run the corrected exact-v51 lifecycle replay before interpreting economics or changing the route.
